en.summary: Kling has announced that Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. en.summary: Xinzhi Zhang and Zhao Song of Microsoft Research have proved the Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture, posed in 1995, showing that for log-concave distributions the gap between the optimal hyperplane cut and cuts of arbitrary shape does not grow with dimension and is bounded by a universal constant.
en.reason: Microsoft Research's Xinzhi Zhang and Zhao Song proved the 1995 Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits conjecture, showing the optimal-cut gap for log-concave distributions is bounded by a fixed universal constant, not growing with dimension, and removing a theoretical barrier to high-dimensional randomized algorithms.

en.summary: Wiz disclosed that a malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 was uploaded to PyPI at 11:39 UTC on October 21 and quarantined at 1:20 UTC; related image tags on GHCR and Docker Hub were also compromised and removed around 13:53 UTC. The latest safe version is v1.106.2.

items.title: ChinaTalk 解读中国商务部 AI 技术出口管制新规草案
items.summary: 中国商务部与科技部于 10 月 16 日发布 2026 年第 48 号公告，拟向技术出口管制目录新增 40 项技术，其中 23 项涉及 AI，包括 6 项禁止出口和 17 项许可管理，并即日生效临时出口登记制度。

items.title_en: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE vulnerabilities affecting 70% of the Internet

items.recommend_reason_zh: Wiz Research 在支撑全球70%网站的 core PHP 核心引擎发现可未认证RCE并泄露密码、API keys的漏洞，波及 PHP 5.4 以来版本、CVSS 达9.2，文章讲述 frontier AI 如何助力挖出这些隐藏十余年的缺陷。

en.summary: Wiz Research discloses multiple memory safety vulnerabilities in the PHP core (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS scores up to 9.2) that enable unauthenticated remote code execution and memory disclosure, affecting versions dating back at least a decade to PHP 5.4.
en.reason: Wiz Research found unauthenticated RCE and memory-disclosure flaws in core PHP (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS up to 9.2) affecting versions back to PHP 5.4 and roughly 70% of websites, and the piece details how frontier AI helped uncover these decade-old defects.

items.title: AI 搜索是怎么做出来的
items.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。

en.title: How AI search is built
en.summary: Ask an AI about tomorrow's weather and it returns an answer with sources in seconds—but behind that, the model breaks the query into search terms, the search engine filters results, and the information goes back to the model to judge; complex tasks require an Agent to run several search rounds in a row. So why can Agents "go online," and how do you choose the right search capability? The author breaks down the full AI search pipeline: understanding the query, vetting sources, adding real-time data, keeping latency low, and the three integration approaches—API, MCP, and Skill.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s scheme and Yuanbao’s open API frame a ChatGPT search-plugin author’s breakdown of how AI search splits queries, filters sources, loops results back to the model, runs multi-round Agent searches via API, MCP or Skill, and delivers Beijing’s 3–14°C forecast.

en.title: One title, two third-place finishes! These friends who met at an AI bootcamp took their projects onto the Anker hackathon podium
en.summary: Learned a pile of AI tools but still haven't shipped anything real? Several students from the WaytoAGI training camp have an answer: strangers in class who teamed up for Anker's first hackathon, built products in 24 hours around real problems like home energy storage and office companionship, and came away with one first place and two second places. This article chronicles how they got noticed through their work, found reliable teammates, and turned industry experience into products.
en.reason: WaytoAGI training-camp classmates who met as strangers in class teamed up for Anker's first Shenzhen hackathon, building home-energy-storage and office-companion products in 24 hours and taking one championship plus two third places.

en.title: Agents use 30x more tokens: DPUs take the load off CPUs. An AMD blog post citing Gartner says agentic AI consumes 5–30x more tokens per task than an ordinary chatbot.
en.reason: Gartner data cited by AMD shows agentic AI consumes 5–30 times more tokens per task than chatbots, and running Microsoft's accelerated connection service on AMD DPUs saves 22 CPU cores per server.

en.title: Lobster (OpenClaw) seems to have lost some of its buzz, but personal AI agents are suddenly exploding.
en.reason: Within two months, xAI's Grok Bot (August 11), Meta's Muse (September 8), OpenAI's Dots (September 29) and Anthropic's Claude Duet (October 21) all shipped personal AI agents with independent cloud environments that check email and calendars and act on their own, the same capability that once made OpenClaw stand out.

items.title: 目前AI已达高度先进阶段：前沿模型（如Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6等）在科学、数学、编程多数基准上超越人类专家，智能体可独立处理数小时复杂任务，AI正加速自身研发（部分实验室AI主导超25%工作）。SI尚未完全实现，但进展极快，有观点认为奇点已开始，AGI或在近1-2年内出现。 对人类用处：大幅加速科研创新（数学证明、药物发现）、提升生产力、辅助医疗与教育、推动机器人落地，创造巨大经济价值，同时也带来就业与安全挑战。

en.title: AI has now reached a highly advanced stage: frontier models such as Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 outperform human experts on most science, math, and coding benchmarks, agents can independently handle complex tasks lasting hours, and AI is accelerating its own R&D—at some labs, AI drives more than 25% of the work.
en.reason: Frontier models such as Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 now surpass human experts on most science, math and coding benchmarks, agents handle multi-hour tasks independently, and AI drives over 25% of work at some labs, with the piece weighing AGI timelines of one to two years against gains in drug discovery, math proofs, healthcare and education.

en.title: If you're building an AI fortune-telling or divination app, this 57GB open-source dataset is ready to use.
en.reason: A 57GB open-source dataset covering 1950–2026 holds 675,000 Zi Wei charts and 8.77 million interpretations across 13 dimensions, rule-generated without AI and checked against Ni Haixia’s Tianji and Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu and released under CC BY 4.0.

en.title:
Brute Force Works Wonders: OpenAI Enters Omics Analysis

Saw this interesting bioRxiv preprint on X: a collaboration between OpenAI's Rosalind team, Scripps scientist Xin Jin, and PerturbAI's Grace Zheng.
en.reason: OpenAI's Rosalind team, with Scripps' Xin Jin and PerturbAI's Grace Zheng, deployed over 2,000 parallel GPT-Rosalind agents to interpret a mouse whole-brain in vivo Perturb-seq atlas spanning millions of cells and nearly 2,000 gene perturbations.

items_ai.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。

en.title: How AI search is built
en.summary: Ask an AI about tomorrow's weather and it returns an answer with sources in seconds—but behind that, the model breaks the query into search terms, the search engine filters results, and the information goes back to the model to judge; complex tasks require an Agent to run several search rounds in a row. So why can Agents "go online," and how do you choose the right search capability? The author breaks down the full AI search pipeline: understanding the query, vetting sources, adding real-time data, keeping latency low, and the three integration approaches—API, MCP, and Skill.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s scheme and Yuanbao’s open API frame a ChatGPT search-plugin author’s breakdown of how AI search splits queries, filters sources, loops results back to the model, runs multi-round Agent searches via API, MCP or Skill, and delivers Beijing’s 3–14°C forecast.

en.title: Lobster (OpenClaw) seems to have lost some of its buzz, but personal AI agents are suddenly exploding.
en.reason: Within two months, xAI's Grok Bot (August 11), Meta's Muse (September 8), OpenAI's Dots (September 29) and Anthropic's Claude Duet (October 21) all shipped personal AI agents with independent cloud environments that check email and calendars and act on their own, the same capability that once made OpenClaw stand out.

en.title:
Brute Force Works Wonders: OpenAI Enters Omics Analysis

Saw this interesting bioRxiv preprint on X: a collaboration between OpenAI's Rosalind team, Scripps scientist Xin Jin, and PerturbAI's Grace Zheng.
en.reason: OpenAI's Rosalind team, with Scripps' Xin Jin and PerturbAI's Grace Zheng, deployed over 2,000 parallel GPT-Rosalind agents to interpret a mouse whole-brain in vivo Perturb-seq atlas spanning millions of cells and nearly 2,000 gene perturbations.
